title: Historic Miscellaneous Book Mixed Old 03
description:
The ‘Historic Miscellaneous’ themed assets capture the humble, handmade feel of everyday life in earlier times. Featuring high-fidelity scans of wooden doors, bowls, baskets, books, simple furniture, and assorted household objects, this collection reflects ordinary items worn by daily use.
Ideal for creating rustic period dwellings and set dressing with a strong sense of realism and environmental storytelling.
